correctness.rationale: At each box-layer vertex, an integral shear splits off one orthant ray per positive fiber and the remaining tangent cone is the homogenization of a coordinate-box Cayley sum with precisely 2^r extreme rays over each other column. This proves all adjacency/degree/edge formulas. The exact excess of rays over dimension is sum(2^r-1)-|Z|, nonnegative with equality only for disjoint singleton supports. Under simplicity, each other-column singleton block has primitive determinant equal to its positive integer entry, giving the iff lattice criterion. The simplex-cube type follows from a simplex base and successive strict interval bundles. Standard-library exact rational rank/determinant verification checked 1686 matrices and the motivating family identities through d=50; finite checks are not substituted for the general proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 Cayley construction was designed to produce IDP and smooth Ehrhart-counterexample polytopes, but its local degeneracies at zero entries were not classified in the defining paper. The complete graph and edge formula for all support patterns, a clean iff simplicity and smoothness criterion, a simplex-cube combinatorial classification and the exact rare/high-degree nonsimple stratum of the headline counterexample matrix provide a natural structural solution rather than a narrow arbitrary numerical instance. The same formula distinguishes combinatorial invariance from lattice smoothness and is reusable for other coordinate-box Cayley families.
